As the sole survivor of Vault 111, only you can rebuild and determine the fate of Fallout 4's Wasteland. Join multiple factions vying for power or go it alone - the choices are yours.

Experience exciting first- or third-person combat with the dynamic Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System, or V.A.T.S., targeting enemies for maximum tactical advantage (and cinematic carnage!)

Collect, upgrade and build thousands of items with Fallout 4's crafting system, including weapons, armor, and even your own customizable settlements. Welcome home.

about.description:
From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year. 

You are the sole survivor of Vault 111, emerging into a world reduced to ash by nuclear war. Every moment is a battle for survival, every decision shapes the future. Rebuild, reshape, and reclaim the Wasteland—your way. 

Welcome home.

Freedom and Liberty
Do whatever you want in a massive open world filled with hundreds of locations, characters, and quests. Join factions, forge alliances or go it alone. The choices are yours, and every one of them matters.

You’re S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
Create your own unique character with the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. system. Choose from hundreds of Perks and develop your own playstyle, whether you’re a smooth-talking diplomat, stealthy sniper, or walking tank in Power Armor.

Collect and Build
Scavenge, craft, and customize like never before. Build thousands of items—armor, weapons, food, and more—and even construct and manage entire settlements across the Commonwealth.

Immersive First- or Third-Person Combat
Use the dynamic Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System (V.A.T.S.) to slow down time in combat and target enemies with cinematic precision—or take the fight into your own hands with real-time gunplay.

about.description:
For ten years, Fallout 4 has stood as one of the most celebrated open-world RPGs of all time. Now, the Fallout 4: Anniversary Edition brings the complete post-nuclear epic together in one definitive package. Winner of over 200 “Best Of” awards including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year, this edition includes the acclaimed base game, the 6 official expansions, and more than 150 Creation Club items.

Includes the full base game and the 6 official expansions:
•	Automatron
•	Wasteland Workshop
•	Far Harbor
•	Contraptions Workshop
•	Vault-Tec Workshop
•	Nuka-World

Plus, over 150 Creation Club items, featuring unique weapons, power armor sets, building packs, paint jobs, one of a kind homes, and even have Dogmeat take on the appearance of another breed, to enrich your journey through the Commonwealth.

Celebrate a decade of adventure, survival, and choice in a world forever changed. The wasteland is yours to explore again.

You are the Sole Survivor of Vault 111.
Two centuries after the bombs fell, you emerge into a world gone to hell—but it’s still yours to shape. Scavenge, shoot, talk, and build your way through the ruins of civilization. Every choice counts. Every second is a fight for survival. And the fate of the Wasteland? That’s entirely up to you. The Commonwealth’s calling. Time to answer.

The 6 Official Expansions
Whether you’re battling murderous machines, exploring a massive island off the coast of Maine, or liberating a raider-run theme park, there are hours of additional content to enjoy. Also don’t forgot to take a break to run your own Vault by building traps, arenas, or complex machines.

150+ Creation Club Items
Outfit yourself with unique weapons, power armor, building packs, and more with over 150 Creation Club items to expand your adventures through the Commonwealth. 

Freedom and Liberty
Do whatever you want in a massive open world filled with hundreds of locations, characters, and quests. Join factions, forge alliances or go it alone. The choices are yours, and every one of them matters.

You’re S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
Create your own unique character with the S.P.E.C.I.A.L. system. Choose from hundreds of Perks and develop your own playstyle, whether you’re a smooth-talking diplomat, stealthy sniper, or walking tank in Power Armor.

Collect and Build
Scavenge, craft, and customize like never before. Build thousands of items—armor, weapons, food, and more—and even construct and manage entire settlements across the Commonwealth.
